assessment_unit: one trace for its labeled detector
timely_detection_rule: First detection on or before the final labeled step

latency.workload: actual guard.check over held-out fixture steps; excludes models/tools
latency.standalone_embedding_workload: same observable thought texts; separate from checks
latency.embedding_cost: included in warm guard checks; backend is identified separately

limitations: Small correlated synthetic corpus; counts are per trace, not independent production incidents.
Human label review is pending unless the corpus review record says otherwise.
Default thresholds are unchanged; calibration traces are excluded from held-out metrics.
Circuit outcomes use all detectors, independently of the trace's single target label.
Raw detector metrics do not prove actual provider/tool savings or production adoption.
